# Real Sparks

> Real Sparks makes small, calm games. Fun, simple, low pressure. Just games that respect your evening. Real Sparks is the independent game studio of Matthew Haber, based in Norwell, Massachusetts. All games are free and play in a web browser.

## Pages

- [Real Sparks home](https://realsparks.net/): the studio home page
- [About](https://realsparks.net/about.html): about Matthew Haber and Real Sparks
- [Games](https://games.realsparks.net/): every Real Sparks game, free to play in the browser

## Matthew Haber

Matthew Haber is the owner of Real Sparks, an independent studio based in Norwell, Massachusetts. He has worked in website design and marketing for 30 years, and he designs and develops the small, calm browser games published by Real Sparks.

Games by Matthew Haber:

- Popeka!: https://games.realsparks.net/popeka/
- Thrink: https://games.realsparks.net/thrink/
- Twinnow: https://games.realsparks.net/twinnow/
- Scribble Siege: https://games.realsparks.net/scribble-siege/
